title: Detailed helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='19' width='4' height='9' fill='#c8d0e8'/>

  <path d='M52 33 Q64 33 66 42 L52 42 Z' fill='#3ac8e8'/>

  <path d='M72 45 L92 48 L92 52 L72 50 Z' fill='#d89a20'/>

  <rect x='26' y='68' width='6' height='2' fill='#c8d0e8'/>
  <rect x='74' y='68' width='6' height='2' fill='#c8d0e8'/>

  <rect x='44' y='57' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b87a10'/>

  <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='3' fill='#ff6a4a'/>
